summary: Frontend testing of Smart Investing rollback (Option B): all CTAs (hero, pills, nav, footer, FeaturedFinancialSection, /category/smart-investing, /product/keystone-investors-club) now route through the lead-capture modal -> cinematic full-screen transition -> external Keystone URL in new tab. Found and fixed 1 critical bug (missing imports in Hero.jsx). After fix: 24/25 frontend checks pass. Backend /api/leads + admin login verified via curl.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Was importing non-existent `SMART_INVESTING_INTERNAL_PATH` and was missing `useKeystoneOnboarding` import + hook call. Resulted in `ReferenceError: openOnboarding is not defined` whenever the Hero CTA or any external-url hero pill was clicked. This broke: hero-cta-start, hero-category-pill-smart-investing, and would have broken any other external_url pill. Replaced import to `SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL`, added `import { useKeystoneOnboarding } from "../lib/keystone-onboarding"`, and `const { openOnboarding } = useKeystoneOnboarding();` inside the component.

Admin login POST /api/auth/login works with admin@crluys.com / CrLuys2026!; /api/admin/leads returns list of 22 leads including the test submission
minor_observations: The 'Opening Keystone…' line uses animationDelay: 0.5s; inner_text captured 0ms after appearing returned empty for that line. Visually it renders correctly within ~0.5s. Not a bug.

During the cinematic transition the test's instrumented window.open recorded 1 extra call with url=null prior to the correct call. Likely a benign listener invocation; the correct second call with the Keystone URL and _blank target fires as designed.

Recommend a project-wide grep for any remaining references to internal_path / SMART_INVESTING_INTERNAL_PATH / SmartInvestingPage in case anything else lingers (none found in current run).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Smart Investing CTAs verified end-to-end including cinematic transition (z-[120], full-screen, CrLuys logo, 'Financial Freedom Changes Everything.' headline) and window.open(external, _blank). Hero.jsx fix applied: replaced SMART_INVESTING_INTERNAL_PATH import with SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL and added useKeystoneOnboarding hook. Mobile (390x844) verified.
rca of the issue: Root cause: When the /smart-investing internal flagship page was rolled back (Option B), the constant SMART_INVESTING_INTERNAL_PATH was removed from /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js, but Hero.jsx still imported it and used a now-undefined `openOnboarding` symbol. Reproduction: visit /, open browser console, click 'Start Your Transformation' or the Smart Investing hero pill -> Uncaught ReferenceError: openOnboarding is not defined. Mitigation applied: updated Hero.jsx imports to use SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL and added `const { openOnboarding } = useKeystoneOnboarding();`.
